purpose: Nested canonical subsamples. core_400: universal fixed set for EVERY model (closed-source + Qwen first pass) -- all cross-model paired comparisons (H1 Wilcoxon, RQ4 Kendall tau) are restricted to this set. qwen_1000: Qwen-only CC-stratified superset of core_400 (containment verified programmatically, see this script's assertions) for the within-L4 CC-gradient analysis (H4b); the qwen_1000-minus-core_400 extension is deferred behind the P4 coverage-fill critical path. See PROVENANCE.md for full rationale.
cc_recomputed_note: All `cc` values are this project's own AST-based compute_cc() on the target function only, NOT the vendored ULT/PLT cyclomatic_complexity field (see PROVENANCE.md).
